text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Brian. That was some incredible
running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It sure felt like it. That might've been the
best I've ever done.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
After all, it was the most I've ever wanted
to win.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I think the last couple of races pushed you
to grow in a way the
victories didn't.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I think the last couple of races pushed you
to grow in a way the
victories didn't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'm not going to stop here. My
urge to run is what I'll use to
propel me
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of me is where my sister's waiting.
She's the person I still need
to defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell she really means it—her eyes
shine passionately as she
speaks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So, when's my next race? I'm starving!
